label: Model asset directory
help: Prepare the pinned 7.66 GB IndexTTS-2 and auxiliary snapshots. Runtime only reads verified local files; no downloads.

label: Inference Python executable
help: Dedicated Linux Python 3.10/3.11 environment with the pinned Index SDK. Empty uses the app interpreter, only if compatible; nothing is installed automatically.

label: Voice reference audio
help: Required at synthesis time: finalized, non-silent local clip of 0.5–15 seconds, at most 32 MiB. Use only a voice you are authorized to reproduce.

label: Completed audio directory
help: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names; no overwrites or automatic deletion.

label: Emotion
help: Keep the reference delivery or request one of the model’s eight emotion directions. English and Chinese only; no text-to-emotion model.

label: Inference device
help: CUDA is recommended for interactive use. CPU is explicit and slow; unavailable CUDA never silently falls back.

label: Completed file format
help: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 22.05 kHz. No direct live audio stream.

label: Temperature
help: Official model sampling control. Higher values increase variation; not a voice identity selector.

label: Top-k sampling
help: Number of candidate audio tokens retained by the official sampler.

label: Numeric precision
help: Float32 on CPU or CUDA. Float16 requires CUDA; CPU plus float16 is refused rather than silently changed.

label: CPU threads
help: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.

label: Maximum audio duration (seconds)
help: Reject the entire result if it exceeds this duration. Each segment must also end naturally before its token limit.

label: Maximum text characters
help: Reject oversized text. The model also enforces its own combined text/audio token window.

label: Total request deadline (seconds)
help: Verification, model loading, synthesis and publication must finish within this deadline; at most 240 seconds for managed execution.

label: Process address-space limit (MiB)
help: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it; otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA can reserve large virtual ranges. Not a RAM/VRAM reservation.

label: Required available RAM (MiB)
help: Refuse loading below this available-RAM threshold. Default 16 GiB; this check does not reserve memory or guarantee GPU capacity.

label: Pending request limit
help: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the current job and clears earlier pending requests.

label: Top-p sampling
help: Nucleus-sampling probability for the main audio-code generator.

label: Repetition penalty
help: Official Index autoregressive-code repetition penalty. Default 10; not a guarantee against repeated speech.

label: Requested emotion strength
help: Used only when choosing a specific emotion. Zero uses the reference conditioning; exact perceived expression is not guaranteed.

label: Maximum audio tokens per segment
help: A segment must end with the native stop token. Exhaustion rejects the whole file; nothing is cut and labelled complete.

label: Text tokens per segment
help: Official tokenizer’s segment target; punctuation grouping may produce a longer segment. The total number of segments is separately bounded.

label: Maximum segments
help: Reject text requiring more segments before audio generation. Every expected segment must finish before publication.

label: Silence between segments (ms)
help: Silence inserted by the official SDK between synthesized text segments; included in the total audio duration.
